subject.title: Feature: Global session reset on auth switch

question: Should a global auth switch refresh only automatically selected session credentials, or also replace explicit per-session auth-profile pins and interrupt active runs?
rationale: Current main intentionally distinguishes explicit pins, automatic profile selection, CLI auth epochs, and hard session reset; repository behavior cannot determine the desired cross-session policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Refresh automatic selections
options.body: Preserve explicit session pins and active conversation state while invalidating auto-selected auth and runtime bindings for subsequent turns.

options.title: Force every session
options.body: Replace explicit pins as well, with operator.admin authorization and a defined cancellation policy for active runs.

options.title: Retain individual resets
options.body: Keep the documented per-session /new or /reset workflow and decline a global refresh surface.

recommendation.title: Refresh automatic selections
recommendation.body: Preserve explicit session pins and active conversation state while invalidating auto-selected auth and runtime bindings for subsequent turns.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest history across the Gateway reset lifecycle and previously retained the issue for this product decision.
